names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 8 august, «Sfântul Preot Mucenic Alexandru din Basarabia», with the rank words left off. The page nowhere prints his surname.

office: Priest of the church of Alexander Nevsky at Călărași

birth.note: doxologia.ro: «S-a născut în 14 aprilie 1861, într-o familie de preot».

death.note: doxologia.ro: «A fost deportat la Kazan, Tatarstanul de azi, unde a decedat curând, în ziua de 7 august 1941».

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 8 august — «Sfântul Preot Mucenic Alexandru din Basarabia»

attestations.note: The day page keeps him on 8 august; his own page gives no feast day and dates his death to 7 august 1941. The day of the calendar is the one recorded here, and the one-day difference from the day of his death is left standing as the pages have it.
